mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') THEN r.principal_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalPrincipalBalance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') THEN r.bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalBonusBalance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') THEN r.principal_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) + r.bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalBalance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.payment_time) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.payment_time) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN r.recharge_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rechargeThisMonth, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.payment_time) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.payment_time) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN r.bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bonusThisMonth, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_status = 'refunded' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.refund_time) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.refund_time) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundThisMonth, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.payment_time) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.payment_time) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN 1 END) AS rechargeCountThisMonth, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') AND CAST(r.payment_time AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 END) AS rechargeCountToday, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') AND CAST(r.payment_time AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE THEN r.recharge_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rechargeAmountToday FROM recharge_records r WHERE r.deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(r.plan_name, '自定义') AS planName, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(r.recharge_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM recharge_records r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') GROUP BY r.plan_name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CAST(r.payment_time AS DATE) AS rechargeDate, COALESCE(SUM(r.recharge_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM recharge_records r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') AND r.payment_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY CAST(r.payment_time AS DATE) ORDER BY rechargeDate ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rechargeCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.recharge_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM recharge_records r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') AND r.payment_time >= #{startTime}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.bonus_amount - b.remaining_amount), 0) AS expiringBonusAmount, COUNT(*) AS expiringBonusCount FROM bonus_balance_details b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 'active' AND b.expire_time IS NOT NULL AND b.expire_time <= #{expireThreshold}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT r.member_id FROM recharge_records r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.payment_status IN ('success','partial_refunded') GROUP BY r.member_id HAVING SUM(r.principal_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) + r.bonus_amount) < #{threshold} ) t
